name: lpqi_pathfinder
label: LPQI-Pathfinder: NOT + TNG (ORM, La Palma)
sources: NOT technical details page (not.iac.es), GPS position 28 45 26.2 N, 17 53 06.3 W, 2382 m

Caporali & Barbieri, 'The astronomic and geodetic coordinates of the Telescopio Nazionale Galileo, Canary Island': WGS84 geodetic 28 45 14.4 N, 342 06 39.4 E (GPS, 1996-11-22, planimetric uncertainty ~5 m); the astronomic coordinates (28 45 28.3, 342 06 22.1) are the local-vertical values and are NOT used
lapalmaqi.es: the Pathfinder pair is quoted as '550 metres apart'
notes: Baseline 531.8 m at position angle 226.7 deg (TNG south-west of the NOT) from the two surveyed positions (NOT GPS; TNG WGS84 geodetic survey of Caporali & Barbieri, ~5 m): this supersedes the 471 m of the Wikipedia coordinates and is 18 m short of the project's rounded '550 m'. load_array('lpqi_pathfinder', baseline_m=550.0) uses the published figure.
Unequal pair: the generator's telescope2 / detector2 give the TNG its own telescope; the photon budget uses sqrt(A1 A2).
Default detector: the MPD single pixel (Pathfinder primary since 2026-10-09); campaigns override it through their backends.
